 In 742 , he passed the imperial examination for the civil service , but failed to obtain a position . He was 30 years old . He was disappointed , but did not give up . He continued to study and write poetry . 
 In 744 , he met Li Bai , the most famous poet of the Tang dynasty . They became friends and travelled together for a year . They wrote poems about each other .
